description: One submission to the Most Wanted board: a teardown report, a bounty request, a hardware offer, or a public document. Rules encoded here come from the Registry bounty rules: no sealed (NDA) material, no circumvention material, personally owned hardware only, public sources only.

noSealedMaterial.description: The submission contains no sealed/NDA material and no circumvention material.

ownHardware.description: Any teardown was performed on hardware the submitter personally owns and legally acquired.

publicSourcesOnly.description: Everything submitted derives from public sources or the submitter's own examination.

bounty.description: Required when kind is bounty-request; null otherwise.

level.description: Foundry level: L0 silicon, L1 interconnect, L2 controllers, L3 systems.

document.description: Required when kind is document; null otherwise.

docStatus.description: Only public or public-research documents are eligible. Sealed (NDA) documents and circumvention material are refused by rule and are not valid values here.

offer.description: Required when kind is hardware-offer; null otherwise.

condition.description: Working, faulty, for parts, unknown - plus any damage notes.

region.description: Coarse region only (country/state). Never an exact address.

review.description: Filled in by the board during review, not by the submitter.

boardId.description: The most-wanted.json entry id once merged.

contactPrivate.description: Optional email for the board only. Never published, never copied into the board data file.

name.description: Display name or handle. Published with the entry.

teardown.description: Required when kind is teardown; null otherwise. Follows the Contribute page autopsy format.

reportUrl.description: Where the full report lives (a page, a repo file, or a pull request).

title: BareBoard community submission
